subject: Kenjaku
q: Who is Kenjaku?
served: Personality Kenjaku Personality Despite constantly assuming different identities, Kenjaku retains a strong core personality. He is calm and calculating, rarely displaying signs of panic or distress. Kenjaku is a forward thinker who is always working on some kind of scheme and often has entire scenarios planned out in advance. At times he can appear cheerful, playful, and even charming, but deep down, he is a manipulative and deeply egotistical individual who will stop at nothing to further his ambitions regardless of who he harms. Abilities and Powers / Overview Kenjaku Abilities and Powers / Overview Overall Skill Level: Kenjaku is an ancient sorcerer who has accumulated a wealth of jujutsu-related knowledge and experience over the course of a thousand years.(Chapter 145, Episode 50) His advanced understanding of jujutsu sorcery is second to none with numerous feats that display his talent. As Noritoshi Kamo, Kenjaku created the Cursed Womb: Death Paintings and became known as the most evil curse user in history.(Chapter 134, Episode 46) He is the only person who knows how to turn a sorcerer into a cursed object after death, something not even Sukuna knew how to do during the Heian Era.(Chapter 228) He is also the second most powerful barrier user after Tengen, recognized as one of few sorcerers who can match them in barrier techniques.(Chapter 145, Episode 50)(Chapter 206) Chapters 134-228, Episodes 46 and 50 Trivia Kenjaku Trivia Kenjaku's name contains the kanji for "net" 羂 ken and "string, thread" 索 saku. This name is likely a reference to Infallible Lasso Avalokitesvara, also known as Amoghapāśa, who is one of six commonly depicted forms of the Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara. His name is 不空羂索観音 (Fukūkenjaku Kannon) in Japanese. Amoghapāśa is described as a powerful savior who uses his infallible lasso to capture living beings drifting in the ocean of suffering and settle them on the shore of Liberation. subject: Toji Fushiguro
q: Who is Toji Fushiguro?
served: Plot Details Chapter 145 Plot Details However, the unexpected occurred eleven years ago when Toji Fushiguro intervened. He was a man who escaped cursed energy and therefore was not bound by the chains of fate that affect the jujutsu world. In effect, Toji destroyed the destinies of Tengen, the Star Plasma Vessel, and the Six Eyes. Along with him came Suguru Geto, a boy who could manipulate cursed spirits. Once Kenjaku secured Prison Realm six years ago, all his plans fell into place. Personality Toji Fushiguro Personality As a non-sorcerer raised in the Zenin clan who values cursed techniques above all, Toji is a man who has suffered due to the interests of the sorcerer clans in a very similar manner to Maki Zenin. His evil actions result from his dejection towards the jujutsu world as he attempts to spite it. Born without cursed energy, Toji eventually left the Zenin clan and married a woman, taking her name "Fushiguro".(Chapter 66, Episode 25) Her kindness helped Toji change his ways. He stopped gambling and hunting sorcerers; it was likely her influence that stopped Toji from taking revenge on the Zenin clan. However, after her death, Toji reverted back to his old, cold, self.(Fanbook) He sold their son to the Zenin clan because he believed in young Megumi's potential to be a real sorcerer,(Chapter 113, Episode 40) naming him "Megumi" because it means blessings.(Chapter 73, Episode 28) Chapters 66 and 73, Episodes 25 and 28 Plot Details Chapter 97 Plot Details Confused, Takuma Ino looks across the roof of Shibuya Tower at Ogami and her grandson, who has shapeshifted into Toji Fushiguro. Ino figures out the old woman is a necromancer and he can tell with just one look that Toji is ridiculously strong. q: What trivia is recorded about Sukuna?
served: Trivia Sukuna Trivia One theory states that Ryomen-Sukuna is a symbol of twins and brothers, therefore it refers to Ōusu no Mikoto 大碓命 and Ousu no Mikoto 小碓命 (i.e. Yamato Takeru no Mikoto and his brother), twins in ancient Japanese history. Another theory states that Ryomen-sukuna refers to Emperor Chuai's 仲哀天皇 Chūai Tennō sons, Kagosaka no Miko 麛坂皇子 and Oshikuma no Miko 忍熊皇子. Both pairs of brothers are deeply related to Mino and Hida Provinces. Takeuchi-monjo 竹内文書 (an ancient text which recorded the lineage of ancient kami and a dynasty preceding Emperor Jinmu) wrote Hida Province as "日玉國" or "日靈國" Hitamakuni, indicating that Hida was Takamanohara 高天原 and Kuraiyama Mountain was the Pyramid. It is considered that Ryomen-sukuna had a Hida-based dynasty the same size as the Yamato Dynasty. subject: Maki Zenin
q: Describe Maki's appearance (hair, build).
served: Appearance Maki Zenin Appearance Maki is a young woman above average height with an athletic build. She has small green eyes (amber in the anime) and long black hair (dark green in the anime) normally tied into a short ponytail. She had fringes of hair over her forehead with smaller strands framing her cheeks and used to sport different pairs of glasses that allowed her to see curses. Appearance Tsurugi Okkotsu Appearance Tsurugi is a teenage boy of average height, with a slender yet distinctly muscular build. His spiky brown hair dramatically juts outward towards the front, framing sharp, discerning dark brown eyes. His facial features bear a striking resemblance to members of the Zenin Clan, particularly his grandmother, Maki, and cousin, Megumi Fushiguro. Tsurugi's Jujutsu High uniform consists of a brown, high-collared jacket with a full-zip closure and three-quarter length sleeves, paired with matching trousers. Underneath his jacket, Tsurugi's torso and arms are heavily bandaged from his training. He completes his attire with sandals, and his most prominent accessory, aside from his cursed tool, is his grandfather's ring, which he wears suspended around his neck. Appearance Yuki Tsukumo Appearance Yuki is a very tall young woman with a slender yet athletic build and light skin. She has long blonde hair that extends well down her back with two tufts on in front of each side of her face. She has wide brown (pink in the manga) eyes with thin eyebrows and pronounced eyelashes. Appearance Yuji Itadori Appearance Yuji is a young man of average height and appears to have a slender build when wearing baggy clothing, but actually has a lean and muscular physique. He also has relatively large light brown eyes and spiky pink hair (brownish blonde in the manga) that's styled in an undercut fashion. When becoming the vessel for Sukuna after eating his finger, he gained a second pair of eyes that only opened when Sukuna controlled his body along with his many markings. Appearance Kou Usami Appearance Usami is a tall man with a lead build. He has short, slick-back brown hair and dark brown eyes. Despite his age, he has a few strands of white hair as a result of stress.(Modulo Volume 1) Usami wears a formal light-brown suit with a black high-collar shirt underneath, complete with a pair of light-brown pants and black dress shoes. He wears white gloves to conceal his hands' cursed seals. During his first meeting with Jabaloma, Cross Val Vol Yelvori, and Dabura Karaba, Usami wore a white shirt underneath his suit with a black tie. (Modulo Chapter 2) Modulo Chapter 2 Appearance Keita Oe Appearance Keita is a young man with a slim build and a fairly unintimidating appearance. He has light-colored hair and dark eyes with thin eyebrows and freckles on his cheeks. When Keita was first charged, his hair was about mid-length, reaching to his ears. After spending time in jail, his head was shaved to a buzz cut by the time of the first trial. Appearance Hagane Daido
